title: finite support compositor coefficient
statement: Fix distinct primes $p,\ell$, a field $k$ of characteristic $p$, separated finite-type $k$-schemes $X,Y,Z$, smooth $k$-morphisms $f:X\to Y$ and $g:Y\to Z$ of pure relative dimensions $d,e$, and compactifications $c_f,c_g,c_h$ of $f,g,fg$ [sk-def-sfb-dc-setting, def-sbc-smooth-morphisms]. Let $\varphi:A\to B$ be a unital map of finite commutative rings, each killed by a power of $\ell$. For $R=A,B$ let $D_R$ be a FiniteAdjointCompositorDatum [def-sp-adjoint-compositor-data], with compact-support restrictions $F_{f,R},F_{g,R},F_{h,R}$ and compositor $\alpha_R$ normalized on every bounded-below etale witness. Suppose scalar extension $S_X$ [det-sp-scalar-extension-functor] preserves $\Dctf$ on $X$. Write $b_f,b_g,b_h$ for the specified ambient reductionDirectImageComparison maps [det-sp-reduction-direct-image]. For every $M\in\Dctf(X,A)$, the following equality holds in the intrinsic $B$-linear derived category on $Z$: $S_Z(\alpha_A(M));b_h(M)=b_g(F_{f,A}M);F_{g,B}(b_f(M));\alpha_B(S_XM)$, using diagrammatic composition. No right-adjoint or tower comparison is asserted.

source.place: (2), left coefficient equation from etale origin, composition and refinement

proof.text: Choose a bounded constructible etale origin L of M. Exact comparison pullback commutes with tensor and its invertible unit detects zero cohomology sheaves, so L has the Tor interval of M.

Apply the coefficient/site composition theorem to L and the three specified compactifications. Use its refinement equation if they were obtained through a compatible tower. The normalization fields of the two finite data and compact-site coherence identify its site compositors with alpha_A and alpha_B.

Cancel the invertible scalar/site boundary maps. Naturality along the etale-origin isomorphism transports the equation to M, with precisely the specified reductionDirectImageComparison maps and full B-module actions.

theorem finiteSupportCompositor_coefficient
    (k : Type u) [Field k] {X Y Z : Scheme.{u}}
  [X.Over (Spec (.of k))] [Y.Over (Spec (.of k))] [Z.Over (Spec (.of k))]
  [IsSeparated (X ↘ Spec (.of k))] [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spec (.of k))]
  [QuasiCompact (X ↘ Spec (.of k))]
  [IsSeparated (Y ↘ Spec (.of k))] [LocallyOfFiniteType (Y ↘ Spec (.of k))]
  [QuasiCompact (Y ↘ Spec (.of k))]
  [IsSeparated (Z ↘ Spec (.of k))] [LocallyOfFiniteType (Z ↘ Spec (.of k))]
  [QuasiCompact (Z ↘ Spec (.of k))]
  (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ Z)
  [f.IsOver (Spec (.of k))] [g.IsOver (Spec (.of k))]
  (cf : Compactification f) (cg : Compactification g) (ch : Compactification (f ≫ g))
    [QuasiCompact f] [QuasiCompact g]
    (ℓ p : ℕ) [Fact ℓ.Prime] [Fact p.Prime] (_hpℓ : p ≠ ℓ) [CharP k p]
    (d e : ℕ) [SmoothOfRelativeDimension d f] [SmoothOfRelativeDimension e g]
    {A B : Type u} [CommRing A] [CommRing B] [Finite A] [Finite B]
    (_hA : ∃ n : ℕ, ∀ x : A, (ℓ ^ n) • x = 0)
    (_hB : ∃ n : ℕ, ∀ x : B, (ℓ ^ n) • x = 0) (φ : A →+* B) 
    (DA : FiniteAdjointCompositorDatum A cf cg ch)
    (DB : FiniteAdjointCompositorDatum B cf cg ch)
    (hSX : ∀ M : spFiniteConstructibleTorCategory X A,
      spFiniteConstructibleTor X B ((scalarExtensionFunctor φ X).obj M.obj))
    (M : spFiniteConstructibleTorCategory X A) :
    (scalarExtensionFunctor φ Z).map (DA.alpha.hom.app M).hom ≫
        (reductionDirectImageComparison φ ch.i ch.g).app M.obj =
      (reductionDirectImageComparison φ cg.i cg.g).app
          ((finiteAdjointSupport A cf DA.hFf).obj M).obj ≫
        (reductionCompactSupport B cg.i cg.g).map
          ((reductionDirectImageComparison φ cf.i cf.g).app M.obj) ≫
        (DB.alpha.hom.app ((reductionCtfScalar φ X hSX).obj M)).hom
